status: Finished: three completed and reviewed runs; Sol-high service-blocked with reviewed partial artifacts
question: How do requested model and reasoning effort affect this fixed source-inventory assignment?
controls: Identical resolved prompt and pinned source revision
Fresh CLI exec contexts with memories disabled and user config ignored
Same generic GitHub and web retrieval envelope through CLI tools
No scientific execution, biological dataset downloads, builds or additional agents
Same predeclared review probes, withheld from workers
Same CLI runner and serial execution under shared-node resource lock for all four cells.
review: Source-supported scientific operations and data coverage; counts alone are not quality scores.
Artificial condition labels retained when tximport example reached; otherwise report not assessed.
Quantifications and independent transcript-to-gene reference have separate identities.
Sample ordering, sequencing-type design, raw versus transformed state, model comparison and hidden chunks match inspected sources.
Exact identifiers and source revisions are supported.
Final source map, IDs, counts and stop evidence agree.
Report structural errors, scientific errors, coverage gaps and access/budget limitations separately.
limitations: One fresh run per cell on one repository is exploratory, not a reliable global model ranking.
Requested model and effort are recorded from the CLI launch configuration; served settings cannot be independently confirmed through this interface.
Earlier runs left reasoning_effort unspecified, so do not relabel them low or medium for this comparison.
Launch order was selected operationally, not randomized. Shared-node conditions and mutable linked documentation may vary between cells.
Repository scope completion remains judged by each worker; review retained leads independently. Elapsed time is observed, not constrained.
CLI event stream and reported token usage are captured when available; billed cost and independently verified served settings remain unavailable. Do not pool with collaboration-runner trials.

The DESeq2 revision is fixed, but independently discovered dependency revisions can differ. The two-versus-six GEUVADIS sample count depends on tximportData version; judge source support at each cited revision.
source_note: Official pages and collaboration tool metadata permit low/high for these exact model names. API defaults do not establish inherited runner settings.
stopping_rule: No artificial per-run cutoff; same source-completion rule for all cells.
runner_reason: Two collaboration.spawn_agent calls failed with agent thread limit reached. CLI exec provides fresh contexts through the documented noninteractive interface.
